roles.title: Product Manager - Internal Tools and AI

bullets: Own how Wave’s general work tools get used. You’re accountable for tools like Slack, Monday, and AI serving teams well. You work with the People team and other stakeholders to…
Help operations teams use AI efficiently and safely. You find the use cases where it truly saves teams time and turn those into shared skills, bots, and templates others can pick…
Care about the person, but solve for the company. There are far more problems than you can take on, so you pick the ones that help the most teams. You turn each solution into a…
Make sure each problem gets solved the right way. You’re the expert on how people organize work in general, but behind every workflow sits domain context, constraints, and…
Build the team this work needs, starting with you. In your first few months you’ll spend much of your time in-country with our operations teams as an IC, setting up workflows…
Own the developer experience holistically, including any internal or external tooling needed to support it.
Research and implement solutions for how we can use AI to remove engineering and development friction.
Build your own prototypes to test ideas where possible.
Relentlessly gather feedback (by talking to users and looking at data) to deeply understand the problem space and our engineers’ and product managers’ needs.
Work from first principles to understand the engineers’ and product managers’ biggest problems and then figure out how our tooling should work to solve those problems.
